## Threaded Example

```{r}
library(tma)
library(rENA)
library(magrittr)

data("test_reddit2", package = "tma")
reddit_data <- data.table::as.data.table(test_reddit2)
for(i in 1:nrow(reddit_data)) {
  parent <- reddit_data[i, ]$ParentID
  
  parent_vec <- c(reddit_data[i, ]$ID)
  if(parent != "N/A") {
    parent_vec <- c(parent, parent_vec); 
    while(parent != "N/A") {
      next_parent <- reddit_data[ID == parent, ]$ParentID
      
      if(next_parent != "N/A") {
        parent_vec <- c(parent_vec, next_parent)
      }
      parent <- next_parent
    }
  }
  
  reddit_data[i, parents := list(list(parent_vec))]
}
# Model Setup ----
reddit_code_cols <- c("LetsOpen","Economy","TooSoon","Politics","Spread")
reddit_units_by <- c("Author2");
test_window_size <- 4;
reddit_conversation_rules <- conversation_rules(
  (ID %in% unlist(UNIT$parents))
);
reddit_split_fun <- function(unit, unit_context) {
  unit_rows <- unit_context[unit, c("user", "ID", "parentID", "parents"), on = names(unit)]
  split(
    unit_rows[, {
      res2 <- unit_context[ID %chin% unlist(.SD$parents), ];
      res2$TMA_GROUP <- .GRP
      res2
    }, by = seq(nrow(unit_rows))], 
  by = "TMA_GROUP")
}

threaded_accum <- tma::accumulate_threads(
  data = reddit_data,
  units_by = reddit_units_by,
  code_cols = reddit_code_cols,
  conversation_rules = reddit_conversation_rules,
  conversation_splits = reddit_split_fun,
  window_size = 4
)
threaded_model <- rENA::ena.make.set(threaded_accum)

rENA::ena.plot(threaded_model) %>% 
    rENA::ena.plot.network(network = colMeans(as.matrix(threaded_model$line.weights)))
```
